Scale: the plate is square and white, and it is cropped. I take it as roughly 24–26 cm across, so the corn pieces at about 5 cm in diameter and 4 cm tall look reasonable.

Corn: there are two cobettes, each roughly 4 cm long and 5 cm across. Each is about 80 g including the cob, so about 160 g in total. I'll count the edible kernels as roughly 110 g at 96 kcal per 100 g.

Cooked red rice: the pile covers about 12 × 10 cm and is roughly 2 cm high. That gives about 120 cm³ of loosely packed rice, or around 100 g, at about 120 kcal per 100 g.

Arugula: a handful of leaves, about 12 g.

Red pepper: two or three strips, about 20 g.

Pineapple or potato: one small yellow piece, about 10 g.

Macadamia or garlic: one round pale piece, about 5 g.

No oil or dressing is visible.
